summary: Duloxetine carries a boxed warning in the United States, which is the strongest warning from regulators, for risks of mental health harm including suicidal thoughts and behaviors in young people, as well as heart harm [3][7]. The drug label also includes a warning for liver damage, which can sometimes lead to fatal liver failure [7]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score for liver risk and a high score for heart risk [M]. Additionally, a research trial studying the drug for pain control was stopped because too few people signed up and there were too many harmful side effects [10].
